name: Kujou Io
source:
Skills: Cooking, calligraphy
Hobbies: Playing with dogs, taking care of her brother, photographing
Likes: Her brother, BL doujinshi, [url=http://www.justonecookbook.com/temaki-sushi-hand-roll/]temaki sushi[/url]
Dislikes: Cup ramen, mathematics

[spoiler]Io is the illegitimate daughter of Nissha, the younger sister of Queen Pachya of Aznirol and Yahiro's father Kengo. She was raised in Japan never knowing who her true parents were.[/spoiler]
